name: wedding-planner-os

scripts.build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && next build

//overrides: sharp: Next 15.5 declares an optional sharp ^0.34.3 and resolved a second,
nested copy at 0.34.5 — vulnerable to the libvips CVEs in GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj.
The app's own uploads already go through the top-level sharp 0.35.3, so the
attacker-supplied path was never on the vulnerable copy; the nested one is
reachable only via /_next/image, which cannot fetch remote images because no
images.remotePatterns are configured. Pinned anyway so one version ships.
postcss: 8.4.31 carries four advisories (XSS via unescaped </style>, arbitrary
.map disclosure via sourceMappingURL). Build-time only and our CSS is our own,
but 8.5.26 satisfies Next's declared ^8.4.31 range, so this costs nothing.
It also drags postcss's nested nanoid past the <3.3.17 advisory.
